Privacy Policy

Last updated: 9 October 2026

This policy explains what information Football Live (football-live.site) collects when you visit and how it is used.

Information we store on your device

To remember your choices, the site stores small settings in your browser's local storage, such as your language, light or dark theme and selected time zone. This stays on your device and is not sent to us.

Server logs

Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, processes requests to deliver the site and protect it from abuse. This normally includes your IP address, browser type and the pages requested.

Advertising and cookies

We may show advertising served by Google AdSense and other partners. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to our site and other sites on the internet. You can opt out of personalised advertising at Google Ads Settings, or at aboutads.info.

Visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland are asked for their consent to cookies and personalised advertising through a consent message before such ads are shown.

External links

Our pages may link to other websites, such as broadcasters and leagues. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete personal data, or to object to its processing. We do not ask visitors to create accounts. To make a request, email contact@football-live.site.

Children

The site is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes

We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.
